description_text:
Our client is a leading hospitality group bringing together five unique restaurants in Malta, each offering its own distinctive dining experience while sharing a passion for genuine Italian cuisine, exceptional food, and warm hospitality.
 Position Summary
 Our client is looking for a skilled and passionate Chef de Partie to join their culinary team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a specific section of the kitchen, ensuring that food is prepared to the highest standards of quality, consistency, and presentation.
 Key Responsibilities
 Take responsibility for the efficient operation of an assigned kitchen section.
 Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to established recipes and quality standards.
 Ensure all food preparation is completed efficiently and to the required standards.
 Maintain high standards of food quality, presentation, and consistency.
 Work closely with the Sous Chef and other members of the kitchen team to ensure smooth service.
 Assist with food preparation and support other kitchen sections when required.
 Monitor stock levels and communicate any shortages or requirements to senior kitchen staff.
 Ensure all food products are stored, labelled, and handled correctly.
 Maintain a clean, organised, and hygienic workstation at all times.
 Follow all food safety, hygiene, and health and safety regulations.
 Support the training and development of junior kitchen team members when required.
 Contribute to maintaining a positive, professional, and team-oriented kitchen environment.
 Requirements
 Must currently reside in Malta. 
 Previous experience as a Chef de Partie or in a similar kitchen position.
 Experience within a restaurant, hotel, or high-volume hospitality environment.
 Good knowledge of food preparation and cooking techniques.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
 Ability to work efficiently under pressure during busy service periods.
 Excellent teamwork and communication skills.
 Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
 Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards.
 Passion for food and a genuine interest in Italian and Mediterranean cuisine will be considered an advantage.
 Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
 What We Offer
 Opportunity to work within a growing and dynamic hospitality group.
 Exposure to a variety of high-quality Italian and Mediterranean culinary concepts.
 Professional and supportive working environment.
 Opportunities for training, development, and career progression.
 The opportunity to be part of a passionate culinary team.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you are passionate about food, take pride in your work, and are ready to grow your career in a dynamic culinary environment, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team dedicated to creating exceptional dining experiences.
